name: Ticket to Nowhere
summary:
Enjoy your movie... if you can ever reach the theater.

You just wanted to catch a late-night screening, but you find yourself trapped in a strangely empty cinema corridor. The lights hum, the posters stare back at you, and the only way out is the elevator at the end of the hall. But memory is a fragile thing, and this place loves to play tricks on your mind.

Ticket to Nowhere is a psychological anomaly observation game where your eyes—and your ears—are your only lifeline.
